segments.sn4.24:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā nerañjarāya tīre ajapālanigrodhe.
segments.sn4.24:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena māro pāpimā sattavassāni bhagavantaṃ anubandho hoti otārāpekkho otāraṃ alabhamāno.
segments.sn4.24:1.4: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn4.24:4.1: “Yaṃ vadanti mama yidanti, ye vadanti mamanti ca;
segments.sn4.24:4.3: Ettha ce te mano atthi, na me samaṇa mokkhasī”ti.
segments.sn4.24:5.1: “Yaṃ vadanti na taṃ mayhaṃ, ye vadanti na te ahaṃ;
segments.sn4.24:5.3: Evaṃ pāpima jānāhi, na me maggampi dakkhasī”ti.
segments.sn4.24:7.3: Tesāhaṃ puṭṭho akkhāmi, yaṃ saccaṃ taṃ nirūpadhin”ti.
segments.sn4.24:8.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhante, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre pokkharaṇī.
segments.sn4.24:8.3: Atha kho, bhante, sambahulā kumārakā vā kumārikāyo vā tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā nikkhamitvā yena sā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkameyyuṃ; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ kakkaṭakaṃ udakā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhapeyyuṃ.
segments.sn4.24:8.4: Yaṃ yadeva hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako aḷaṃ abhininnāmeyya taṃ tadeva te kumārakā vā kumārikāyo vā kaṭṭhena vā kathalāya vā sañchindeyyuṃ sambhañjeyyuṃ sampalibhañjeyyuṃ.
segments.sn4.24:8.5: Evañhi so, bhante, kakkaṭako sabbehi aḷehi sañchinnehi sambhaggehi sampalibhaggehi abhabbo taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ otarituṃ.
segments.sn4.24:8.6: Evameva kho, bhante, yāni kānici visūkāyikāni [yāni visukāyikāni (sī. pī. ka.)] visevitāni vipphanditāni, sabbāni tāni [kānici kānici sabbāni (sī. pī. ka.)] bhagavatā sañchinnāni sambhaggāni sampalibhaggāni.
segments.sn4.24:8.7: Abhabbo dānāhaṃ, bhante, puna bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ yadidaṃ otārāpekkho”ti.
segments.sn4.24:8.8: Atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato santike imā nibbejanīyā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn4.24:9.3: Apettha muduṃ vindema, api assādanā siyā.

lines: Catutthe satta vassānīti pure bodhiyā chabbassāni, bodhito pacchā ekaṃ vassaṃ.
Otārāpekkhoti “sace samaṇassa gotamassa kāyadvārādīsu kiñcideva ananucchavikaṃ passāmi, codessāmi nan”ti evaṃ vivaraṃ apekkhamāno.
Vittaṃ nu jīnoti sataṃ vā sahassaṃ vā jitosi nu.
Āguṃ nu gāmasminti, kiṃ nu antogāme pamāṇātikkantaṃ pāpakammaṃ akāsi, yena aññesaṃ mukhaṃ oloketuṃ avisahanto araññe vicarasi?
Anāsavo jhāyāmīti nittaṇho hutvā dvīhi jhānehi jhāyāmi.
So hi yekeci loke pamattā, tesaṃ bandhu.
Sace maggaṃ anubuddhanti yadi tayā maggo anubuddho.
Yepi pāraṃ gacchissanti, yepi pāraṃ gantukāmā, tepi pāragāmino.
Anupariyagātiādīsu kiñcāpi atītavacanaṃ kataṃ, attho pana vikappavasena veditabbo.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathā medavaṇṇaṃ pāsāṇaṃ vāyaso disvā –

“api nāmettha muduṃ vindeyyāma, api assādo siyā”ti anuparigaccheyya, atha so tattha assādaṃ alabhitvāva vāyaso etto apakkameyya, tato pāsāṇā apagaccheyya, evaṃ mayampi so kāko viya selaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja assādaṃ vā santhavaṃ vā alabhantā gotamā nibbinditvā apagacchāma.
